scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const src=p.join('node_modules','@tensorflow','tfjs-backend-wasm','dist');const dst=p.join('public','tfjs-backend-wasm');fs.mkdirSync(dst,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src)) if(f.endsWith('.wasm')) fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f), p.join(dst,f));"
